contentErrorMissing: Source file does not exist or cannot be read
contentIdle: Click a document on the left to view its content. This panel shows the full content of that document.
outgoingEmpty: This entry has no outgoing relations yet. Click "{{action}}" in the top-right to create the first one.
incomingEmpty: No other entries point to this entry.
addRelationTitle: Create a new relation from this entry

relLabel.extends: extends — adds more detail on top of this entry

referencesHint: Links that appear in the document. Click "Link" to quickly create a relation (within KB) or "Create as new" (for external URLs).
internalUnresolvedHint: Cannot resolve this entry within the KB; treating as an external link
createFromRefTitle: Create a new entry from this reference and link it
createRelHint: A new .md document will be created in the KB for this external reference, with a reference appended to the current document and the index rebuilt.
createRelGroupHelp: Enter an existing group name or a new one (no path separators).
autoSaveHint: Drafts are kept locally every 30s. Press Save (⌘/Ctrl+S) to write the file.
draftPending: A local draft differs from this file.
externalChanged: This file changed on disk while you were editing.
formatHint: Layout only: trailing whitespace, heading spacing, list indentation, and CJK/Latin spacing. Front matter, code blocks, tables, and blank-line count are never touched.
headerHint: Insert the configured standard header at the start of the body without overwriting existing content.
headerNotConfigured: No header template configured yet. Add one in Settings.
headerFrontMatterConflict: The template is YAML front matter and this document already has front matter. Insertion stopped to avoid overwriting; merge manually.
headerAlreadyPresent: The body already starts with this header; nothing was inserted.
headerInsertedUnsaved: Header inserted into the editor; save to write it to disk.
moveTargetPlaceholder: Pick a folder below, or type a new one (empty = KB root)
moveHint: Same KB only. Choose a target folder from the directory hierarchy.
moveConsistency: The id, incoming links, layout position, attachments, and history directory migrate together; any failure rolls everything back.
moveAttachmentsDir: This directory entry's {{count}} attachment(s) move with the folder.
moveAttachmentsFlat: This flat entry has {{count}} attachment(s) that may stay in the old folder, so relative references can break (standard directory entries are unaffected).
versionHistoryEmpty: No versions yet. Saving the document creates the first version.
versionWarningPerEntry: This document has {{count}} versions (warning threshold {{limit}}). Trim old versions to keep history manageable.
versionWarningTotal: KB history is {{size}} (warning threshold {{limit}}). Consider trimming old versions.
versionNotStored: Larger than 2MB: only the summary and hash were kept, so this version cannot be previewed or restored.
versionRestoreDisabledDirty: Save or discard your edits before restoring.
versionRestoreHint: The old content is written back and a new version is appended (restored from this one). Existing versions are kept.
versionRestored: Version restored; a new version was appended.
versionTrimHint: All versions before the selected one will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
versionTrimWarn: Deleted content is NOT recoverable. The selected version and everything after it are kept.
versionTrimAcknowledge: I understand the deleted versions and their content are permanently lost.
